privacy.privacy_unit: one person represented by one row

notes: record_id is excluded before the DP release
all key-sets and numeric bin edges are fixed by public inputs
rare_flag is derived row-wise from the public rare detector and is not released
numeric decoding uses only the public A_bg distribution
sampling, decoding, clipping, and schema formatting are postprocessing
this report includes no statistics computed from the private cohort
S2 bypasses the mbi 1.1.0 conditional round sampler with independent sample draws
the saved model contains only released DP potentials/marginals and public encoding keys
dp_release_count and rho describe this candidate only, not composition with earlier candidates
the rare-row target count is the public A_bg rare rate times the public output size, and target rows are chosen only from the DP output
rare-marker values are copied together from one public A_bg donor row
the fixed donor seed is used only after the randomized DP release
time, onset, and death are copied together from the nearest public A_bg row in a fixed A_bg-derived Cox risk space
